xAI did not answer 31 attempts within the time limit, and the runner sent each such request again. The run stopped twice and was resumed from the last answered question: at 1,696 answers, after one request timed out six times (the limit then went from 15 to 30 minutes), and at 2,144, when a retry sent an expired sign-in token. The usage and cost of the timed-out attempts are unknown.

Latency: the time from sending one request to receiving its answer, measured from our computer, network and any retries within the request included. Request time: the time at least one request was in flight, over the requests whose answers were kept. It is not the run's elapsed time: it leaves out requests that failed and any pause before a run was resumed.
